topic: Checking your credit report vs ignoring it (Ryan vs Nora)

scenes.narration: One in five credit reports has a damaging error. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera at the bench pointing her gavel at a giant credit report with red error circles, comic burst banner reads ONE IN FIVE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ryan and Nora both apply for a three hundred thousand dollar mortgage.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man ryan and woman nora at a bank loan officer desk holding identical mortgage application packets, price tag reading THREE HUNDRED THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both earn the same salary and have nearly identical credit histories.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two identical paychecks and two near identical credit summaries stacked side by side, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ryan never checks his credit report before applying for the loan.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, ryan handing a mortgage application to a loan officer with a confident shrug, a question mark hovering over his head, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He assumes everything is fine and just submits the application.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, ryan on a couch hitting SUBMIT on a mortgage application website, no credit reports open, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Nora pulls all three reports free at annualcreditreport dot com.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, nora at a kitchen table with three credit reports spread out, a laptop showing ANNUALCREDITREPORT DOT COM, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She finds three errors including a closed account marked open.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, nora circling three red errors on a credit report including a CLOSED ACCOUNT MARKED OPEN line, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She disputes each one in writing the same week.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, nora signing three written dispute letters and stuffing them into envelopes, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Six weeks later Ryan is approved at seven and a half percent.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked ryan at a closing table with a paper labeled SEVEN POINT FIVE PERCENT looming over him, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His monthly payment is twenty one hundred dollars on the same house.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, ryan holding a calculator reading TWENTY ONE HUNDRED PER MONTH, a small house photo beside it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Nora's clean report gets her six point two percent.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split scene, left side ryan with a giant payment number, right side nora with a paper labeled SIX POINT TWO PERCENT and a smile, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Pull your credit reports yearly at annualcreditreport dot com. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel, holding up a credit report stamped CLEAN, comic banner reads CHECK YEARLY, kids comic book illustration
